notes.title: Plan to add a Hard Mode and New Anomalies
notes.content:
Plan to add a "Hard Mode"

Hi everyone~ I'm Lokin.Some people say that this game is too boring and too easy, and the fixed number of anomalies in each chapter is too predictable.So, I plan to add a "hard mode" that includes:- Different game loops: Anomalies in the same room will appear randomly in all chapters, for example, anomalies from the original Chapter 3 may appear in Chapter 1- 6 new anomalies per room(these anomalies are harder or scarier)- Boss levels will remain the same, just let me know what you think about themIf you have other ideas or comments, please let me know in the comments.
